notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Palisade Giant indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to yourself or a permanent you control.
description:
Give Palisade Giant indestructible by any method.
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Palisade Giant.
Deal damage to yourself or a permanent you control, with that damage being redirected to Palisade Giant.
Arcbond triggers, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to Palisade Giant to each other creature and each player, with all damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control being dealt to Palisade Giant instead.
Repeat from step 4.
